mechanism: Clonidine reduces renal potassium excretion through alpha-2 adrenergic effects on renal hemodynamics and tubular function, increasing hyperkalemia risk, particularly in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels regularly, especially in patients with baseline renal dysfunction or those receiving concurrent potassium supplements or ACE inhibitors; consider dose adjustments or alternative antihypertensive therapy if hyperkalemia develops.
